problemSigns.detail: This often signals a torsion spring has broken above the garage door opening.

problemSigns.sign: Door won't lift or feels extremely heavy
problemSigns.detail: A broken spring removes the counterbalance, making manual lifting difficult or impossible.

problemSigns.sign: Visible gap in the torsion spring above the door
problemSigns.detail: A clear separation in the spring indicates it has broken and lost its tension.

problemSigns.sign: Door lifts a few inches then stops
problemSigns.detail: This can happen if one of two extension springs breaks, or if a torsion spring has insufficient tension.
Loose or slack cables are a common result of a broken spring losing its tension on the system.
